mentl/b832046:
The session uncovered, the hard way, that discipline written down cannot
enforce itself — Claude drifted with the most rigorous docs it could write
(debugging the symptom before auditing the structure; trusting memory over
the artifact; offering a risk-hedge as a decision; looking up by name what a
graph edge already connects) until the human caught each one. Crystallize
every concerning pattern into its one home so the next session defaults to the
discipline, not the drift.

CLAUDE.md (method): "AUDIT BEFORE THE SYMPTOM" as the load-bearing first move
(Ground-in-reality) + its three corollaries; the docs are the SPEC, not the
GUARANTEE — the discipline is an ACTION taken first, never a paragraph
trusted-as-absorbed (Interrogate-don't-absorb); red-flags for trace-before-
audit, name-lookup of what an edge connects (= re-derivation), and presenting
a fork the thesis already answers (ultimate form wins; don't outsource; never
hedge the wheel against the seed).

PLAN.md (substance): §0 the deepest scale of the Carried-Truth Law — the medium
is its own builder's safeguard, and first-light is the medium becoming able to
enforce its own discipline (docs:Claude :: language:developer :: human:mentl
audit); §2 a verb DRAWS an edge, name-lookup of an edge is the canonical
re-derivation; §7 the verified L1 cursor — delete handler_state_inits_registry
(a Carried-Truth side-ledger), read each handler's arms live across the ~> edge
(the str_concat/offset/effect-poly theories were symptom-chasing, discarded);
§9.6 the law; §10 the resume cursor.

The SessionStart hook injects the lesson + the §7 cursor before any reading.
"Read the three docs" now defaults to the discipline.

Realize the wheel's InferCtx row-accumulation (src/infer.mn:36-118) in the seed,
closing the activation gate for perform-evidence-dispatch. Four coordinated

performs E; mid calls deep; main installs handler) that now compiles AND RUNS

1. THE FUNDAMENTAL BINDING (walk_stmt.wat $infer_register_effect_ops): an
   effect op's type row IS Closed[eff_name] — the op is bound to its effect in
   its very type, at declaration, definitionally. Was a fresh unbound row var,

   top-level fns accumulate (replaces the unused bare-handle push); bind before
   generalize so the scheme carries the resolved row.

   the caller's fresh row var (NRowFree → NRowBound) — the TFun arm unified
   params+return but preserved the row verbatim; now it unifies rows too.

mentl/b840482:
The handler-state effect for emit-time per-fn-body metadata. Two
load-bearing values wired:

  current_body_captures() → Int — fence between captures and
    evidence inside __state. LEvPerform's offset = 8 + 4*captures
    + 4*slot. set_body_captures(n) called at emit_fn_body entry
    with the closure's len(captures).

  current_body_evidence() → List — placeholder for ev_shape lookup.
    Set to [] for now; populated by H1.4 (ev_shape derivation)
    once lower starts producing non-empty ev_slots.

Files:
  types.ka — BodyContext effect declared (4 ops: current/set
    pairs for captures + evidence).
  pipeline.ka — body_context handler (state record: captures + ev).
    Installed in `compile`'s ~> chain right after emit_memory.
  backends/wasm.ka — emit_fn_body takes captures_count, performs
    set_body_captures + set_body_evidence on entry. emit_fns_expr's
    LMakeClosure arm passes len(captures) through. LEvPerform emit
    rewritten: reads current_body_captures, computes the absolute
    offset, emits the proper sequence:
      ;; H1 LEvPerform 'op' via slot N (offset=M)
      (local.get $__state)
      <args>
      (local.get $__state) (i32.load offset=M)
      (call_indirect (type $ftK))

The body's __state implicit first param is pushed BEFORE args (per
the calling convention), then the fn_idx is loaded for the indirect
dispatch through the call type.

clob/b8c23fd:
Adds training for the dense f32 router in MoE blocks. No backprop through
experts is required — the router learns from observed CE advantages of
each routing decision, which is REINFORCE-style policy gradient and keeps
the training localized to W_router.

ExpertRouter gains an accumulated gradient buffer, AdamW first/second
moments, and a counterfactual sampling path. route_counterfactual() draws
a random number against cf_rate and, when it fires, swaps the top-1 and
top-2 experts so the first slot becomes the non-greedy choice. This
breaks the positive-feedback loop the Plan agent flagged — without
counterfactuals, the router would converge on whichever expert it
currently prefers and never get training signal on the alternatives.

accumulate_policy_gradient(hidden, selected, full_probs, advantage)
implements the REINFORCE update:
  dL/dlogit_i = advantage * (full_probs[i] - I[i in selected])
  dL/dW_i    = dL/dlogit_i * hidden     (outer product)
Positive advantage (CE came in below baseline) pushes logits up for
selected experts. apply_adam() runs one AdamW step over accumulated
gradients with independent-per-router state (step counter, m, v) and
clipping, then zeroes the buffer.

Block gains forward_training() which mirrors forward() but uses
route_counterfactual and captures (hidden_at_router, RouteResult) for
MoE blocks so the training loop has both pieces needed for the policy
gradient update. CoreModel gains decode_step_training and router_mut(i)
exposing a specific MoE layer's router.

New train-router subcommand streams a corpus through the model with
counterfactual sampling, maintains an EMA baseline over observed NLL,
and applies AdamW per MoE layer every --batch-size tokens. Writes an
updated-router side-file (same pattern as confidence.bin and meta.bin)
rather than rewriting the full model — the model's save path would be
substantially more work and this keeps the commit focused.

Ingest gains --routers flag. apply_routers_file() loads the side-file
an
clob/b848eed:
The energy critic was a random projection -- its weights were never updated,
so "novelty" was just alignment with a random direction. This commit makes
it learnable and fixes the novelty detector that gates episode storage.

Energy critic (src/nn/energy.rs):
- SGD train_step(hidden, target_nll, lr) on MSE loss
- Serde serialize/deserialize for side-file persistence
- predict() returns signed score; score() remains |predict()|
- Diagnostic: train_mse(), n_trained() for monitoring

Novelty detector (src/crystal/detector.rs):
- Replaced Weber-law multiplicative threshold with z-score threshold
- Weber rule (energy > baseline * 1.5) broke on calibrated critics whose
  outputs cluster tightly around mean NLL -- only 10 episodes stored vs 14k
- Z-score (z >= 1.0 sigma) is scale-invariant: works for both random
  projections and trained critics, flags ~16% right tail
- Running mean + EMA variance with warmup bootstrap

CLI (src/main.rs):
- New calibrate command: streams corpus, SGD-trains critic on per-step NLL,
  saves side-file, emits Pearson(critic, nll) diagnostic
- --critic flag on ingest and eval to load trained critic side-file
- apply_critic_file() helper with dim-mismatch hard error

Model (src/model/stack.rs):
- replace_energy_critic(), energy_critic_mut(), energy_critic() accessors

A/B experiment results (40 modules, held-out eval, same seed):
  Random critic:     1212.65 -> 1091.39  (-10.0%)
  Calibrated critic: 1212.65 ->  892.22  (-26.4%)

The calibrated critic produces modules that reduce perplexity 2.6x more
than random-critic modules. Novelty-targeted episode selection -- storing
episodes the model is actually surprised by -- yields higher-quality
clusters for distillation.

noodles/b8161a1:
The trail is a memory of what was just played; after a dice roll it kept
drawing a line between wedges the reroll had re-meant (seen on device: a
gold thread from Eb through a C-major sector). refreshStatic is called
on exactly the harmonic-context rewrites - key/scale/mode commits, dice
via refreshAll, undo, project load, sheet reopen - so it now forgets the
trail there, and playback regrows one within a bar. The three rim-band
grab dots are dropped on the builder's call: the whole rim band is the
drag surface anyway, so they marked a hotspot that never existed.

Gating this surfaced a probe bug worth its own paragraph: the armed-tap
assert kept failing only on minor keys, and the tie was self-inflicted.
Pre-setting every slot to degree 6 collides with the theory - in every
minor key the outer H+1 wedge IS degree 6 (VII), so tap-b wrote the
pre-set value straight back over tap-a's slot in the same bar, net zero.
The pre-set is now a borrowed {pcs} sentinel no diatonic tap can equal.
Two more hardenings from the forensic chain: the probe pins scene 0's
launch to loop/none before arming (a rolled one-shot harmony clip goes
silent and leaves armed taps nowhere to land), and the trail assert now
polls for regrowth after the key travel, which asserts the reset and the
rebuild in one line. Failure messages carry element-under-point, sheet
structure, and playing/mode/scene state. Twelve consecutive full-smoke
runs green on the probe work, three more on this build.
